_doc:
MAGARENG LOCAL MUNICIPALITY (Warrenton, NC). One-page 'TAX INVOICE' summary statement, account [number removed], VAT 4840122032. 10 bills = 10 consecutive months Oct-2025 .. Jul-2026 (filenames are junk: 'oct/nov/des/jan/mrt/apr/june' plus 'MAG_[number removed]_[number removed].pdf'=Feb-2026, 'MAG_[number removed]_telkom (1).pdf'=May-2026 and 'MAG_[number removed]_telkom.pdf'=Jul-2026 -- ALWAYS read the month from the 'Date :' line).

LETTER-SPACED MASTHEAD: the invoice heading is drawn glyph-by-glyph, so read_pdf() returns 'T A X     I N V O I C E', NOT 'TAX INVOICE'. Any pattern or fingerprint on 'TAX INVOICE' matches ZERO files. The scanned copy (Feb-2026) OCRs the same heading as 'TAX   INVOICE'. Nothing is fingerprinted on the heading at all; the fingerprint is the municipal VAT number 4840122032 plus 'MAGARENG'. Whole-tree substring counts over all 487 PDFs: 4840122032 = 10 files / 1 folder, MAGARENG = 10/1, MAGARENG MUNICIPALITY = 10/1, 'T A X     I N V O I C E' = 9/1 (the 9 text bills), and a contiguous 'TAX INVOICE' = 360 files / 42 folders -- which is exactly why no pattern in this profile contains the string TAX or INVOICE.

ONE SCANNED BILL: MAG_[number removed]_[number removed].pdf (208KB, Feb-2026) has no text layer AT ALL (pymupdf get_text() returns 0 chars; the page is a single image), so read_pdf(ocr='auto') OCRs it (scanned=True, ocr=True, the row is force-flagged OCR by the app). Tesseract destroys the 'Amount Excl' COLUMN ONLY on that file ('GOMRZ SS 2', 'MS 5.93 Om)', '| OE', '2 OPES)', 'TY [number removed]') while the 'Vat Amt' and 'Amount Incl' columns survive intact. Every ex-VAT figure is therefore a prefer(printed Amount Excl, Amount Incl - Vat Amt) chain, and the strict 3-column ex-VAT patterns simply MISS on the scan rather than returning garbage.

The derived ex-VAT values on the scan (energy 69125.32, kVA 15593.07) were confirmed four independent ways: (a) they sum to the intact printed '23962.9 Kwh -   84718.39' line to the cent; (b) with the other five charge lines they sum to the intact printed grand-total Amount Excl 87596.28 to the cent; (c) a 400-dpi re-render re-OCRed with --psm 6 reads the ex column as '69 125. 34' / '155.93 0m)', i.e. the same figures with one digit misread (69125.34 is excluded by (b), which only closes on ...32); (d) 69125.32 / 23922 kWh = R2.8896/kWh, identical to Jan-2026 (80518.85/27865 = R2.8896) and Mar-2026 (59973.09/20754 = R2.8897).

LAYOUT. Header: masthead + 'VAT Reg No', 'Tel No', 'Fax No'; addressee block (TELKOM SA LTD / PRIVATE BAG X137 / CENTURIAN -- never fingerprinted, 136 files in the tree carry it); 'Date : <Month> <YYYY>', 'Account No :', 'Market Value :', 'Stand Size :'; then the property address ('0 STRUWIG' / 'WARRENTON'). Then the meter table:
    Meter-No:   Previous:   Current:   Consumption:
     [number removed]    157735      181140      23404      <- kWh meter
    E[number removed]   0           0           0          <- 2nd meter, always zero
          KVA    0           38          38         <- max demand kVA
Then a ledger head (BALANCE BROUGHT FORWARD / LESS PAYMENTS RECEIVED / PLUS PAYMENTS REVERSED / ADJUSTMENTS / SUB TOTAL) and the charge table under 'DEBITS RAISED FOR THE MONTH  Amount Excl  Vat Amt  Amount Incl':
    ASSESSMENT RATES - BUSINESS          (no VAT column: 2 figures only)
    ELECTRICITY BUSINESS                 energy
    KVA METER                            <- printed TWICE: a bare label line
    KVA METER            <ex> <vat> <incl>  and the real charge line
    WATER BUSINESS                       <- bare label, no figures, no water meter
    BASIC REFUSE BUSINESS ONCE PER WEEK
    BASIC ELECTRICITY BUSINESSES
    BASIC WATER BUSINESSES
    INTEREST ON ARREARS                  (Dec-2025 only)
and a bare 3-figure grand-total line, 'Amount Due :', an Advance/90+/60/30/Current aging strip, 'Deposit Amount:' and a payment slip.

THE 'Kwh -' LINE. One line reads '<units> Kwh -   <amount>', e.g. '23443.3 Kwh -   82473.19'. The amount is the PRINTED ex-VAT total of the two metered electricity lines (ELECTRICITY BUSINESS + KVA METER) and it is intact on all 10 files including the scan; it is the anchor for total_ex_vat_r. The units figure is kWh + kVA + a small fraction (23404 + 38 = 23442 vs 23443.3) so it is NOT total_kwh -- it is kept as the native mag_units_billed only. Its position drifts (Jun-2026 prints it after BASIC ELECTRICITY BUSINESSES).

JUN-2026 SHAPE: the kWh meter row is absent from the meter table (replaced by a bare '0 0 0' line) and there is no ELECTRICITY BUSINESS line -- only KVA METER. So start/end reading, total_kwh, standard_kwh and standard_r are correctly BLANK on that bill and the 'Kwh -' line reads '43.5 Kwh - 16637.27' = the kVA charge alone. That is data, not a miss (those rules are required:false).

MONEY is space-thousands with a DOT decimal ('67 629.64', '156 124.12'), and the grand-total/aging lines print no thousands separator at all ('180346.13'). There are NO comma decimals anywhere on this layout (verified: 0 comma characters in all 10 raw texts), so the stock money cleaner is correct and there is no 100x _to_decimal trap. The default money token is (?<![\d.])-?\d+(?:[ ]\d{3})*\.\d{2}(?![\d]) -- ONE space in the thousands run, which is what the text layer prints.

OCR-TOLERANT LAST-RESORT PATTERNS. Tesseract normalises every whitespace run on the scanned copy to exactly THREE spaces, so on that file a thousands separator and a column gap look identical ('10   368.80   79   494.12'). Three rules therefore carry a FINAL fallback pattern whose money token is (?<![\d.])-?\d+(?:[ ]{1,4}\d{3})*\.\d{2}(?![\d]) -- mag_energy_vat_r/incl, mag_kva_vat_r/incl and mag_rates_incl_ocr. They are reached ONLY on the scan (the strict patterns provably match nothing there), and they were checked to return byte-identical values to the strict patterns on all 9 text bills. The wide token is deliberately NOT used on the BASIC ELECTRICITY / BASIC WATER lines, where the strict single-space token already succeeds on the scan and the wide one would glue an OCR junk digit onto the VAT figure ('| OE   2   106.16' -> 2106.16 instead of 106.16). The leading group is \d+ (not \d{1,3}) so that a separator-less number such as 180346.13 still reads whole, and every continuation group is exactly \d{3} so that '2   10   368' cannot glue.

NOT PRINTED ANYWHERE (mapped '_none', not regex misses): reading period start/end dates (the only dates are the payment cut-off 'UP TO yyyy/mm/dd' and a meaningless 'Due Date:  0'), Actual/Estimate flag, peak / off-peak registers (single-band business tariff), NMD, Cash, Guarantee, Security Held. 'Deposit Amount:' IS printed (0.00 on every bill) -> deposit_r.

RULE ZERO. total_ex_vat_r = the PRINTED 'Kwh -' ex-VAT figure + the basic electricity charge, while standard_r / demand_r come from the Amount Excl column (or Incl-Vat). So the reconcile check genuinely tests energy_ex + kva_ex == the independently printed 82473.19-style figure. The only shared term is the basic charge (R707.72, 0.4-0.9% of the bill); that much is circular and is stated in the report. The full independent identity is the grand-total line: elec + kva + basic elec + rates + refuse + basic water (+ interest) == printed Amount Excl total -- max deviation R0.00 on all 10 bills including the scan. Two more: printed grand-total Vat Amt == sum of the per-line Vat column (R0.00 x 10), and full ledger closure BALANCE BROUGHT FORWARD + LESS PAYMENTS + PLUS REVERSED + ADJUSTMENTS + grand-total Amount Incl == 'Amount Due :' (R0.00 x 10).

TWO BILL-SIDE QUIRKS, both the municipality's own arithmetic, not extraction errors. (1) The printed 'SUB TOTAL' line is unreliable: it prints 0.00 on Oct/Nov/Dec/Jan/Feb even where BALANCE BROUGHT FORWARD + LESS PAYMENTS is non-zero (Dec-2025 leaves R87105.72 unpaid and still prints SUB TOTAL 0.00). Do not use it as a ledger term; mag_subtotal_r is captured but nothing derives from it. (2) The aging strip closes to 'Amount Due' on 9 of 10 bills but is R87015.96 short on Dec-2025 for the same reason. (3) The meter reading columns are integers while the billed consumption carries hidden decimals, so end_reading - start_reading differs from the printed Consumption by exactly 1 on Oct-25, Dec-25, Apr-26 and May-26 (0 on the other five). The 'Kwh -' units figure exposes the decimals: 21979.9 kWh + 47.9 kVA = the printed 22027.8 on Oct-25.
